problem_or_genesis_goal: Sidebar labels are tracked uppercase and several controls are shorter than a 44px touch target.
reproduction_evidence: Headless Chrome at 375x812 showed WORKSPACE, RECENT, and MODEL CONNECTION in uppercase. Nav rows are 41px and icon buttons are 31px in src/styles.css.
user_impact: The shell is harder to scan and the narrow layout misses the WCAG 2.2 target size used by the v4 accessibility floor.
indivisibility_proof: The labels live in App.tsx and the row heights live in styles.css. Both are required for the same U09 pass.
non_goals: Do not redesign the lime accent or the welcome headline
Do not change approval or filesystem behavior

acceptance_oracles.description: No horizontal overflow, no sub-11px text, no transition-property all at 1440, 768, and 375.
Existing provider and safety tests still pass.

metamorphic_invariants: Changing a label to sentence case does not change which screen a nav button selects
A control that was keyboard-focusable stays keyboard-focusable
